ValidationRule.description: This validation is created as part of STY-03984. When updating the primary checkbox of Case Contact, The Account on the Case Contact's Contact Account should match with Case Contact's case Account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( PRIORVALUE(NSP_IsPrimary__c) = false, NSP_IsPrimary__c = true, NSP_Case__r.AccountId != NSP_Contact__r.AccountId, $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.NSP_CaseContactTrigger__c != true)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact is not associated with this account. Please remove it.
